0022600144.text: Cleveland (2-1, 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back, 6th in the East) enters on a two-game winning streak with a 2-0 home record and a 0-1 road mark, while Atlanta (2-2, 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back, 7th in the East) has lost two straight and is 0-1 at home. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Cleveland's last meeting with Atlanta was a 124-102 loss in Atlanta on April 10, 2026.
